components.name: Fish Button
components.description: Start fishing. Flips to red while the line is out.
components.css: .ds-btn-fish { padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2196f3, #1976d2); border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 25px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); transition: transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-fish:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-fish:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffea00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stop Button
components.description: The same button while fishing is active.
components.css: .ds-btn-stop { padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f44336, #d32f2f); border: 2px solid #fff; border-radius: 25px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); transition: transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-stop:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffea00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: HUD Info Box
components.description: Frosted glass readout with a colored left edge.
components.css: .ds-hud-box { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); color: #fff; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; border-left: 4px solid #2196f3; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(5px); }

components.name: Upgrade Row
components.description: One purchasable upgrade with level and cost.
components.css: .ds-upgrade { width: 240px; padding: 10px; background: #333; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #555; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; text-align: left; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-upgrade:hover { background: #444; border-color: #777; } .ds-upgrade:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2196f3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-upgrade-icon { font-size: 16px; margin-right: 5px; }

components.name: Max Badge
components.description: Marks an upgrade at its maximum level.
components.css: .ds-max { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; background: #ff5252; color: #fff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Fishing Tycoon looks like a toy you want to pick up: a saturated tropical sea, a bright sky, and chunky, glossy controls that feel pressable. The 3D scene carries the color. The interface sits on top as dark frosted glass with a single bold accent edge, so numbers stay legible against any sky. Action buttons are the loud, candy-colored exception: gradient pills with a white outline.

The mood is bright, playful and arcade. Every state change should read as a reward or a warning at a glance: green for money, gold for quota, red for stop and max. The look changes with the contract. The sea stays a constant, while the sky moves from day blue to sunset orange to night navy.
keyCharacteristics: Dark frosted-glass panels (blurred, semi-transparent) over a bright 3D scene
Glossy two-stop gradient pill buttons with a white 2px outline
One semantic color per action: blue fish, green sell, gold contract, red stop
Emoji as icons, one per label
A sky that changes per contract while the HUD stays fixed

rules.name: The One Color, One Job Rule
rules.body: Each saturated color owns one meaning: blue is the default action, green is money, gold is the contract, red is stop or max. Never reuse one for decoration.

rules.name: The Sky Is the Variable Rule
rules.body: Only the sky, fog and sun change per contract. HUD colors stay identical so the player's learned meanings hold.

rules.name: The Readable Over Anything Rule
rules.body: Text that sits on the scene itself (key hint, floating numbers) always carries a dark text shadow. Text on panels relies on the glass instead.

rules.name: The Glass Over Solid Rule
rules.body: In-game surfaces are translucent and blurred. The only fully dark overlay is the win screen (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)).

dos: Do keep one color for one job: blue for the default action, green for sell, gold for the contract, red for stop and max.
Do put information on frosted glass (blur 5px, translucent dark) with white text.
Do give every action button a 2px white outline and a 135-degree two-stop gradient.
Do use an emoji as the icon and keep it at the start of the label.
Do give text that sits directly on the scene a dark text shadow.
donts: Don't change HUD colors when the sky changes; only the sky, fog and sun change per contract.
Don't add sharp corners. The smallest radius in the system is 4px.
Don't use a solid opaque panel in-game. Only the win screen is near-opaque.
Don't introduce a second typeface; weight and size carry the hierarchy.
Don't use the gold or green accents for decoration; they signal contract and money.
